name: Morgan's Vigil
summary: Alliance defenders keep watch over the passes to Blackrock Mountain from ruined Morgan's Vigil in the Burning Steppes. Charred homes and a shattered mage tower stand around their camp, the Alliance's only foothold in a land held by Dark Iron dwarves and Blackrock orcs.

sections.title: The Last Hearth in the Steppes
sections.body:
You find Morgan's Vigil on high stone above the fiery wastes of the Burning Steppes. Once a modest settlement, it fell when the horrors of the region overran it. Charred timbers and a cracked mage tower mark what remains. The defenders shelter in rough canvas tents among the soot.

A gryphon roost links the camp by air to Stormwind City across the mountains. Scouts, marshals, and travelers find shelter here from the warbands below.

sections.title: The Long Watch
sections.body: Morgan's Vigil watches against the threat of Blackrock Mountain. The Dark Iron clan delves into dark sorceries, while Blackrock orcs claim the surrounding wastes. So the defenders maintain the camp's defenses and coordinate scouting runs across the ash. They also secure the vital pass leading south into Redridge.

faq.q: What happened to the buildings here?
faq.answer: The village's houses and other structures burned to the ground, and its mage tower crumbled. The surviving inhabitants live in tents among the ruins. No one identifies who caused the destruction.
Morgan is the woman who gave the vigil its name. She is not among the defenders stationed at the camp now.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance maintain this camp?
faq.answer: The Alliance keeps this camp as its only fortified vantage point in the Burning Steppes. It guards the northern pass to Redridge and watches troop movements around Blackrock Mountain. Swift supplies and reinforcements come directly from Stormwind.

faq.q: How can I travel to and from Morgan's Vigil?
aliases: how to get to morgans vigil
faq.answer: An Alliance gryphon master connects Morgan's Vigil directly to Stormwind City, Lakeshire, Nethergarde Keep, Thorium Point across the Searing Gorge, and Farholde Keep in the Riverglades.

faq.q: Is Morgan's Vigil safe from attack?
faq.answer: Alliance sentries guard the outpost, but its perimeter remains exposed. Wandering beasts, fiery elementals, and raiding orcs lurk just beyond the ridge.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you find your only safe sanctuary in the Burning Steppes on this battered bluff. Flights connect directly to Stormwind City, and defenders marshal resistance against the Dark Iron and Blackrock threats.
As a human, you know holding this ridge keeps horrors from beneath Blackrock Mountain from pouring unchecked through the pass into Redridge's vulnerable valleys and the heart of Stormwind.
